reagent.name: Venom Reagent
reagent.lore: Sickly green and still bubbling. The Reagent Offering in the Spore Court wants it.

venom_key.name: Venom Key
venom_key.lore: Opens the sealed hatch to the Venomheart Chamber.

onDone.text: The valves bleed the line. The hatch to the sludge causeway opens, and a cache hatch opens in the south wall.

onStep.text: A valve screams and gives. The second.

mechanics.jam: The valve is seized. The north valve first.

onDone.text: Fans spin up. The gas thins to nothing, and a drain hatch opens somewhere in the Spore Court.

waves.say: The spores rise. Things shake themselves free of the mould.

onDone.text: The spores settle. A vial of Venom Reagent glows on the plate.

onOpen.text: The dish froths. A quarantine hatch hisses open in the south wall.

mechanics.hint: A cauldron dish, dry and stained, waiting for a reagent.
mechanics.verb: tips the Venom Reagent into the dish and a hatch hisses open.

onOpen.text: The sealed hatch to the Venomheart Chamber opens.

mechanics.hint: A sealed hatch, hazard-striped, with a keyhole in the wheel.
mechanics.verb: turns the Venom Key and the sealed hatch hisses open.

encounters.say: Glass hisses. The lab is still running without anyone.
Spores drift in the court. A dry dish waits in the south.

bosses.name: The Venomheart
bosses.intro: The Venomheart uncurls from its sac. Burst the three slime wards on the pillars to open its guard.
bosses.deathText: The Venomheart bursts and the chamber exhales.

shield.breakText: The slime wards burst! The Venomheart is exposed!
shield.relapseText: The wards reform and The Venomheart calls its servants.

effects.text: The sac pulses and the air thickens.

completion.intro: The Venomheart Marsh. Bleed the lab valves, then cross the sludge before the gas finds you.
completion.message: The gas clears. The marsh closes shortly.
